_doc: Machine-readable data-source registry (read by the UI). One record per source. acquisition_date is when the thing on the ground was observed (imagery flight, lidar flight, map edit snapshot); publication_date is when the provider released it; ingestion_date is when it entered THIS project (from meta.json 'built' fields or file mtimes). Processing dates are never used as acquisition dates. Human-readable twin: docs/DATA_SOURCE_REGISTRY.md. Licence classifications are recommendations pending human sign-off (docs/compliance/COMMERCIAL_USE_APPROVAL.md).

freshness_rules._doc: freshness_status is computed against last_verified from the NEWEST acquisition date of the source (for derived products: the worst status of their inputs).
freshness_rules.imagery_and_elevation: current: < 2 years since acquisition; aging: 2 to 5 years; stale: > 5 years
freshness_rules.crowd_or_vendor_vector (OSM, Overture, r: current: data snapshot < 90 days old; aging: 90 to 365 days; stale: > 365 days
freshness_rules.regulatory (FEMA NFHL): current: fetched < 180 days ago from the live effective service; aging: 180 to 365 days; stale: > 365 days
freshness_rules.live_api: live: queried at request time, nothing durable is cached (status reported as current)

sources.dataset_name: Terrain display products v1 (data/terrain/v1/<Place>/hillshade.png, elevation_tint.png, terrain_rgb/{z}/{x}/{y}.png, contours_5m.geojson, meta.json)
sources.provider: Groundtruth (derived, scripts/build_terrain.py) from the USGS 3DEP lidar bare-earth DTM/DSM (data/lidar/v2)
sources.resolution: hillshade ~2 m/px, elevation tint ~4 m/px (EPSG:3857 images over the place bbox); terrain-RGB XYZ tiles z10-15 (z15 ~3.9 m/px); contours 5 m interval from a 4 m grid

coverage.text: Lake Norman only so far (the demo bbox). Only measured DTM cells (a real return within 5 m AND ground-supported, groundtruth.terrain.measured_mask) are drawn in the images and contours; terrain-RGB tiles FILL the rest (water, outside the lidar project, outside the bbox in edge tiles) for 3D display only, share recorded in meta.json

sources.crs: Images and tiles EPSG:3857; contours EPSG:4326; profiles measured in EPSG:32617
bands: hillshade: RGBA, alpha = shade departure from flat
elevation_tint: RGBA viridis ramp, legend min/max m in meta
terrain_rgb: Mapbox encoding height = -10000 + (R*65536 + G*256 + B) * 0.1
sources.license: Derived from US Government Public Domain lidar (USGS 3DEP); viridis colour map data CC0
sources.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.
sources.access_method: GET /api/v1/terrain/{place}/meta, /{name}.png, /rgb/{z}/{x}/{y}.png; POST /api/v1/terrain/profile (reads the DTM directly)
sources.notes: Elevations in metres, vertical datum NAVD88 by 3DEP convention (the GeoTIFFs carry only the horizontal CRS; not machine-verified). Filled terrain-RGB heights are visual-only and never measurements. Derived status = worst input (lidar 2016 → stale).
